latestVersion.changelog:
alibabacloud-lingjun-node-ops 0.0.1 – Initial Release

- Introduces full lifecycle management for Alibaba Cloud Lingjun (hyper-)nodes, covering stop, reboot, reimage, renewal, spec change, repair, run-command, node group update, tagging, and resource group operations.
- Enforces single-step parameter confirmation before all mutations, supporting both Chinese and English with canonical feature names and prompts.
- Uses a persistent per-session random session ID for observability; every CLI call embeds this in the user-agent.
- Requires read-only inventory retrieval as a prerequisite for all mutating operations.
- Details region support, CLI installation, authentication best practices, and fine-grained RAM permission sets.
- Excludes cluster scaling, node group moves, and file delivery, which are covered by a separate skill.

items.summary: Literature Review Paper Screener is an AI-powered workflow that searches for relevant academic literature, builds structured Evidence Records for each paper, and independently screens and evaluates every paper before auditing and merging the results into an Excel Paper Sheet and prioritized Reading List. The local agent gathers the evidence; the cloud evaluates it.
items.description: Literature Review Paper Screener V1.1. The local agent (internet-enabled, free) searches for literature, collects evidence, builds per-paper Evidence Records with Evidence Availability Levels A-D, submits ONE paper per workbook row to the private LoomLoom Cloud template (rows run as independent parallel tasks, so screening never exceeds the platform per-activity timeout), then audits and merges the returned screening results and renders Excel Paper Sheet + Reading List. Cloud has no internet access; you gather the evidence and it evaluates it. Literature Review task type only; Medical Science focus.

latestVersion.changelog: V1.4.4: validator hardening — reject level-D content-credibility overclaims and enforce record_id-bidirectional paper/reading pool equality.
